statement.task: Lexicon naming-entropy measure. Add Shannon H = -sum(p*log2 p), normalized entropy (evenness = H/log2(distinct)), and perplexity (2^H) to TokenDistribution (a ~2-line addition over the existing freq counts; sits beside Zipf alpha/R2/hapax). Surface in the vocabulary observation's narrate(). KEY: this is over identifier WORD-tokens (naming diversity), a different vocabulary than Halstead's program tokens (code size) — it measures something Halstead never did. Caveat: the token distribution is a Zipf near-invariant, so GLOBAL entropy is descriptive (observation, no honest threshold). The live signal is normalized entropy at a LOCAL scope vs the corpus norm: low evenness = repetitive naming (stutter/sprawl); high evenness + many word-types = grab-bag/low cohesion. Evaluate normalized scope-entropy as a cohesion BATTERY INPUT (grab-bag/stutter), not a standalone rule.
statement.source_note: information-theory reframing of Halstead; cohesion battery input, ties to grab-bag + stutter + lexical-distribution-invariance
